description: Create a formatted data table in WPS Writer using real Amazon Q4 2023 financial data. A blank document is already open and ready for editing. Create a sales report table with the following: (1) Add a title 'Amazon Q4 2023 Regional Net Sales Report' at the top, centered and bold, (2) Create a 5-row by 4-column table with headers: Region, Q4 2023 Net Sales, Year-over-Year Growth, % of Total, (3) Enter the following real Amazon data rows: North America - $105.5B - +13% - 62%, International - $40.2B - +17% - 24%, AWS - $24.2B - +13% - 14%, Total - $170.0B - +14% - 100%, (4) Apply header row formatting: bold text with blue background, (5) Right-align the numeric columns, (6) Add alternating row colors (white and light gray) to the data rows. Save the document as amazon_q4_report.docx using File > Save As (Ctrl+Shift+S) or File > Save As.
